title: Chapter 1061
text:
"What a huge amount of energy. What is this thing? It seems to be coming for me." Gorután was secretly shocked.

In his senses, the energy fluctuations of Han Xiao and Yin Ying overlapped, exuding a powerful aura that made one tremble.

The silver meteor clearly did not come with good intentions.

Gorután's expression changed slightly. He did not sit still and watch this strange thing approach him. While dealing with the entanglement of the Mecha Empire's mechanical army, he freed up his hands and shot out dark brown Shockwave Blast toward the silver meteor.

However, this silver meteor was like a vehicle driven by an experienced driver. It made full use of its speed advantage, and its position was very coquettish. It was like a racing car drifting, twisting and turning as it dodged the similarly swift dark brown beam of light.

Seeing that his long-range attacks could not do anything to the silver meteor and that the other party had locked onto his back, Gorután's expression became serious. He suddenly exploded with energy and blasted the Apostle Weapons away. Then, he compressed his Pugilist flames and increased the strength of his body. He turned around and faced the silver meteor.

The two streams of light of different colors rapidly closed the distance between them. The next moment, they suddenly collided.

In an instant, the detectors of all the Beast Ancestor spaceships present reacted at the same time. The energy fluctuation displayed broke through the peak!

At the location where the two collided, a dazzling light suddenly lit up like a flashing halo.

The solid dark brown Pugilist flames were like a rock that was heavily smashed by a hammer, instantly exploding.

Gorután's figure spun like a top and shot out. The blood that splattered out was directly evaporated by the energy shockwave from the collision.

At the moment of the collision, Gorután's thoughts seemed to have stopped for a moment. He only felt his vision blur. When he came back to his senses, he realized that he had lost control of his body and was directly sent flying.

Ever since he became a pinnacle Beyond Grade A, he had rarely encountered anything that he could not block. However, the terrifying kinetic energy contained in this silver meteor made him feel like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.

Pugilists were used to bearing the brunt of a head-on collision, but the power of this collision still exceeded Gorutan's expectations. He felt as if every nerve in his body was twitching, sending signals of intense pain to his brain. His heart was shaken.

What terrifying power!

"Who are these people?!"

Gorután was bewildered. He only managed to stabilize himself after flying quite a distance away. He quickly checked his body and found that he had suffered serious injuries from the collision. His mood became very solemn.

He focused his eyes and saw the original appearance of the silver meteor that had stopped. His face suddenly changed and he said in shock,

"Black Star?!"

After hitting Gorután, Han Xiao stopped the car and let Yin Ying roll down the window, revealing his handsome face. He stared calmly at the shocked Gorután.

"We meet again, Beast Ancestor."

"How could it be you? Weren't you staying in Black Star Palace?"

Gorután was bewildered as various possibilities flashed through his mind. Could it be that something had gone wrong with the operation against Hella?

Seeing Han Xiao's strange silver shell, Gorután was very confused. The development of the situation seemed to have deviated from his expectations. He really wanted to know what had happened at the scene.

What is Sorokin doing? Why didn't he tell me what had happened until now?

"I know what you've done behind my back." Han Xiao said slowly. "Hella is out of danger. Your plan has failed. Don't have any more fantasies."

Hearing this, Gorután frowned.

Although he did not know how the matter had been resolved, Black Star did not need to lie in this regard. Seeing how calm the other party was, he knew that the situation was most likely true.

Gorután was unhappy that he had not been able to kill Hella. He had a feeling that his hopes had been dashed.

"Then, you're here to look for me?"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. "Back then, you provoked me and suffered a loss. Then, through some channels, you leaked information to Radiance and Ethereal, wanting to kill me with a borrowed knife. Now that the matter has been exposed … you know what's going to happen next."

Gorután's face darkened.

His secret plan had failed, and he had been exposed by the person in question. Even if he saw Han Xiao as an enemy, he could not help but feel embarrassed.

Gorután was not a person who liked to defend himself. What was done was done. Since the enemy had seen through him, there was no need for him to hide. He suppressed his emotions and snorted.

"What, you want to settle the score with me?"

"I've said it before. If you want to play, I'll play with you to the end. You don't look like someone who can't afford to play. So, there's only one way to solve the problem now. I'm sure you know that." Han Xiao's tone was calm.

"Hmph, in the end, you're still talking with your fists."

Gorután knew that a battle was unavoidable, and flames appeared on his body again.

Schemes and tricks are indeed not suitable for me. Fighting head-on is the most straightforward.

Although he had suffered a loss earlier, Gorután was not afraid at all. They were both peak Beyond Grade As. Who didn't have a trump card? Who was afraid of who?

He took a deep breath of energy and used his energy to stimulate the proliferation of cells, healing his wounds quickly. The lost HP was quickly replenished. A Pugilist's control of the body was close to the extreme. At the peak of Beyond Grade A, his recovery ability would not be too low.

"I didn't fight you last time. Today, I can make up for it. Your deeds are widely spread in the universe. Let me see what you're really capable of." Gorután's eyes were bright, and his tone was filled with strong fighting spirit.

He still did not know about the process of the rescue battle for Hella, and he knew nothing about Han Xiao's recent achievements. His impression of Han Xiao was still stuck at the standard of his previous strength.

At this time, Gorután finally remembered Manison, and his heart skipped a beat.

If his opponent was only Black Star, Gorután was not afraid. However, if the Mecha Empire also joined the battle, it would not be good.

He could not help but turn around, and his heart was filled with joy. He saw that Manison's troops were no longer entangled and were retreating, showing that they had no intention of interfering in this battle.

Han Xiao also looked at the Mechanic Emperor's troops that were gradually getting further away and muttered to himself,

Manison sent Gorután's coordinates to me but did not pick up my call. Is this a show of goodwill, and he wants me to take over this opponent of Gorután for him so that he can continue to stay out of this?

Han Xiao shook his head. He did not care what the director Manison was planning. In any case, he was determined to fight this battle. There was no way he would let go of the initiator of this.

The effect of the Character Summon Card was still there, and it could still be maintained for quite some time. With this explosive combat strength, it should not be a problem to deal with Gorután.

Swoosh!

The secondary dimensional army box opened, and a sea of Mech Legion swarmed out, sweeping through the galaxy.

Gorután was not afraid, and he charged into the endless Mech Legion alone.

As soon as they started fighting, the pressure came crashing down, and Gorután immediately felt that something was wrong.

"Wait, how is your combat strength …"

Gorután's eyes suddenly widened, and his face was filled with astonishment.

He had once felt Black Star's energy level at close range, so he had a rough estimate of Han Xiao's combat strength. However, at this moment, Han Xiao's actual combat strength was far beyond what he had guessed, giving him a huge shock.

This did not make sense. It had only been a month or two, so how did Black Star's combat strength soar to a whole new level?

At this time, Han Xiao's main body did not retreat but advanced instead. He did not activate the Mechanical Deity and actually took the initiative to engage in close combat.

Their fists suddenly collided, and a huge force was transmitted through their arms. There was actually a stalemate, and the shock on Gorután's face became more and more intense.

"How is your strength also …"

"You ask too many questions!"

Han Xiao's movements were so fast that it was as though he had turned into a blur, and he suddenly sent the stunned Gorután flying with a kick.

Just like how cavalry could increase their combat strength with the help of horsepower, when Han Xiao rode on Yin Ying, he could also receive attribute bonuses from him.

Yin Ying was a Pugilist himself, so his Strength and Dexterity bonuses were very high, and he also had a unique defense advantage.

Endless power was transmitted from Yin Ying, and Han Xiao's main body temporarily received attribute bonuses that were not inferior to a Pugilist's. Together with his own attributes, his melee combat strength was greatly increased. Although it was still not comparable to a peak Pugilist, it was still not bad.

In his previous life, a Pugilist like Carrott was like a tiger that had grown wings when he used Yin Ying. However, Han Xiao used Yin Ying more because of his speed and defense advantages. Melee combat was not his main damage output method.

…

At the same time, the dynasty's support fleet sailed out from another stargate.

"We're finally near Black Star's frontline stronghold. Let's hurry over. We don't know how the battle is going. Every second we delay will put Hella's life in danger," Ravenlaude urged.

This time, Kant closed his eyes as if he had received some news. He then opened his eyes and said, "There's no need to rush.

"There's no need to rush over. Black Star has already settled the matter."

Hearing this, Ravenlaude, who was rubbing his hands together, was stunned.

"How is that possible? How did he take care of such a dangerous situation?"

"Here, this is the information from the Black Star Corps." Kant showed the information, which recorded the battle process.

After reading the information, Beyoni's face was filled with shock.

"To think that Black Star was still hiding such a trump card. In his explosive state, he can actually fight against more than ten Beyond Grade As. Unbelievable!"

"It's mainly because Radiance and Ethereal had no choice but to run away. They even held each other back, giving Black Star a chance to take them down one by one … However, I have to say, this battle record of his is really too scary to an outsider."

Kant sighed. "However, burning his potential is too much of a loss for someone with a bright future like him. This will definitely affect his growth … Sigh, Black Star has been wronged this time. The dynasty will definitely compensate him."

This time, Beyoni could not help but think of Kant's joke earlier. His expression became strange.

On the way, Kant had said that he could take on everyone alone. It was originally a joke, but he did not expect it to come true on Black Star.

"Amazing …" Beyoni was impressed from the bottom of his heart.

On the other hand, Ravenlaude froze when he saw this news.

He originally wanted to turn the tide and make Black Star owe him a favor, but he did not expect that Black Star would be able to take care of such a huge crisis alone without the help of reinforcements.

… Doesn't this mean that I made this trip for nothing again? I didn't even get a favor?

Ravenlaude instantly lost his motivation. He only wanted to turn into a salted fish and lie in a corner until the end of time.

"Since the matter is settled, what should we do now? Go to Black Star's stronghold and take a look, or go back directly?" Kohler asked.

Kant shook his head.

"Neither. Black Star seems to be fighting with Gorután … Since we're already here, let's go and see if we can help."

…

On the other hand, in Beast Ancestor's stronghold palace, Sorokin's manifestation held the communicator in his hand and paced back and forth, muttering to himself, "This is strange.

Why hasn't Gorután replied to my message yet? Did something happen? "

Sorokin suddenly had a bad feeling about Gorután's situation.
